drivingQuestion: Whose view governs the end of the time for the evening Shema?
outcomeNote: The halakha is fixed in accordance with Rabban Gamliel.

segments.he: רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר וְכוּ׳: אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה, אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל: הֲלָכָה כְּרַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל.
segments.en: The Gemara returns to explain the mishna, in which we learned that «Rabban Gamliel says:» One may recite Shema until dawn. «Rav Yehuda said» that «Shmuel said: The halakha is in accordance with» the opinion of «Rabban Gamliel.»
